title: Quantum automated learning: numerical simulation code
description: Simulation code and data for the numerical results of Q. Ye, S. Geng, Z. Han, W. Li, L.-M. Duan and D.-L. Deng, "Quantum automated learning" (arXiv:2502.05264). It trains quantum automated learning models on Fashion-MNIST, MNIST, Aubry-André Hamiltonians and cluster-Ising ground states, and draws Fig. 2b–f and Supplementary Figs. 4–8 of the paper from the stored results.
